text: Handling deadlines is an important skill for students and workers. Good time management helps you plan tasks and avoid rushing at the last minute. Prioritization means deciding which tasks are most important, so you focus on them first. Scope management is also useful: if a project is too big, you can reduce it to fit the time you have. Finally, communication matters. If you think you may miss a deadline, tell your teacher or manager early, explain the problem, and suggest a solution. By planning carefully, choosing priorities, controlling scope, and communicating clearly, you can handle deadlines with less stress and better results.
